activities.name: St Martin's Island
activities.note: a government directive bans tourist visits from February to October to restore the island's ecology

windows.reason: tourist visits are allowed, with overnight stays capped at 2,000 people a night
the season reopens, but for day trips only: overnight stays are banned in November

activities.name: Pohela Boishakh and the Mangal Shobhajatra

windows.reason: Bengali New Year, always 14 April in Bangladesh, opening with the dawn Mangal Shobhajatra procession in Dhaka

activities.name: Ratargul Swamp Forest by boat
activities.note: the boat trip needs the monsoon flood; in the dry season the water drains and the forest stands clear of it

windows.reason: the monsoon flood submerges the trees by about three metres, and local boats glide between them
the flood rises from May and drains by early October
